manifest_meta.title: Television chef spotted at winter fair

paragraphs.raw_text: DOC_ID: WLD-0029 EVENT_ID: NONE TITLE: Television chef spotted at winter fair SOURCE_NAME: Daily Roar SOURCE_TYPE: tabloid RELIABILITY: 4 PUB_DATE: 2024-12-19 PUB_TIME: 08:10 COUNTRY: Midgard SECTOR: general LANGUAGE: en --- Television chef spotted at winter fair

[P1] A well-known television chef was spotted at a winter fair in Midgard at the weekend, apparently enjoying a quiet afternoon with family and friends. Onlookers said the chef queued for a hot drink and bought a small wooden bowl from a craft stall.
[P2] The chef declined to comment when approached, though a stallholder said the visit was friendly and low-key. Staff at the fair said visitor numbers were strong despite the cold weather.

[P3] Rumours that the chef is planning a new restaurant in the city remain unconfirmed. A representative for the chef said there was nothing to announce at this time and asked for the family's privacy to be respected.
